capabilities: Shows clips that fit the open note in a side bar
Inserts a clip as a quote, embed or plain text
Counts how often and where each clip is used
Browses, searches and filters a clip library
Reviews a few unused clips each day
disambiguation: Not a clipboard manager or video clipper; it indexes highlights already saved in vault notes.
extras: Part of the Obsi apps. AI and meaning search are optional; the meaning model (15 MB, from Hugging Face) is downloaded once per device and runs locally. Install by hand from the release files if needed.
problem: Highlights saved from books, videos and articles pile up unused because nothing brings them back while you write.

relations.evidence: It works with the clips from ObsiTube, ObsiRead, ObsiLearn, Obsi Bible, Readest, the Obsidian Web Clipper
Web Clipper and others | Any ==marked== text inside a paragraph or a quote
Readest | A list item with the highlight and *page 12*, and an optional **Note:**
Obsi Bible notes are written over by the app, so Clips puts Bible clips in as quotes
add this to your .obsidian.vimrc (needs the Vimrc Support plugin)
It looks for model apps that are running: Ollama, LM Studio, Jan, GPT4All and llama.cpp

requires.name: Ollama, LM Studio, Jan, GPT4All or llama.cpp
AI service key (OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI)

summary: Highlight library that shows the clips fitting the note being written, counts how often each is used, and brings back forgotten ones.
